name: Robin Hill Cable Car
kicker: Cabins over the pines to Truc Lam
summary: Ride the cabins from Robin Hill down over the pine forest to Truc Lam Zen Monastery, with Tuyen Lam Lake ahead and the ridges behind. Go on a clear morning, and pair the ride with the monastery gardens at the far end.
fee: Check on arrival (about 120,000 VND one way)
getThere: Taxi to the Robin Hill station, south of the centre
heroCaption: The cable line over the pines toward Tuyen Lam

notice.title: Plan the ride back
notice.body: The monastery is free, but the cabins are a separate fare. Know when the last car leaves before you walk the gardens, or you will need a road ride back.

body: The line leaves Robin Hill and drops over a valley of pines toward Phoenix Hill. From the cabin you look down on the canopy and across to Tuyen Lam, the reservoir below the monastery. Ride on a clear morning, when the lake view is open.
At the far end, Truc Lam Zen Monastery is the reason most people ride. Walk the gardens, look over the lake, and dress modestly for the halls. With the monastery, plan 1 to 2 hours.

figures.caption: A cabin above the forest, with the ridges behind
figures.alt: Red cable car cabin above the pine forest near Da Lat

gettingThere: The Robin Hill station is south of the centre, on the way to Truc Lam. Take a taxi or Grab from Xuan Huong Lake to the station, then ride the cabins down to the monastery.

legs.heading: From Xuan Huong Lake
legs.body: Taxi or Grab to the Robin Hill cable station.

legs.heading: From Robin Hill
legs.body: Cable car to Truc Lam Zen Monastery, about 30 minutes.

closed: Check on arrival; the line runs in clear weather
admissionNote: About 120,000 VND one way for an adult (Dalattourist desk table); confirm at the station. Truc Lam Zen Monastery is free. A return fare is Check on arrival.
